answer: What keeps this honest is Certified hotel general manager register with hoteliers endorsement, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 379 pays 5306 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One prism of signal, one saffron of cost, one quill of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
